name: robots/hanruihua__rl_rvo_nav
title: rl_rvo_nav multi-robot navigation (mrnav-v1)
intro: rl_rvo_nav multi-robot navigation (mrnav-v1), adapted from hanruihua/rl_rvo_nav. It reads `observation` and `tick`; runs `step_world` and `reset_world`. `step_world`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
